floruit.note: Placed by the house his own three-sentence entry names: he "was the son of Vukan, the brother of Stefan", and `stefan-the-first-crowned` carries a death of 1224, which puts a nephew in the 13th century. The Ohrid Prologue "gives no year", as the life says.
